import base64,hashlib,json,math,pathlib,zlib
from fractions import Fraction as F
R=pathlib.Path.cwd();S=1<<149
PLO=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937510')
PHI=F('3.14159265358979323846264338327950288419716939937511')
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def digest(v):return sha(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode())
def q(v):return F(*v)
def value(w,domain=True):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<64
    e=(w>>52)&2047;m=w&((1<<52)-1);assert e!=2047
    if domain:assert e!=0 or m==0
    sign=-1 if w>>63 else 1
    return sign*F(m)*F(2)**(-1074) if e==0 else sign*F((1<<52)+m)*F(2)**(e-1075)
def nearest(w,x):
    candidates=[t for t in (w-1,w,w+1,0,1<<63) if 0<=t<1<<64 and (t>>52)&2047!=2047]
    assert w==min(candidates,key=lambda t:(abs(value(t,False)-x),t&1,t))
    return value(w)

def value32(w,domain=True):
    assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<1<<32
    e=(w>>23)&255;m=w&((1<<23)-1);assert e!=255
    if domain:assert e!=0 or m==0
    sign=-1 if w>>31 else 1
    return sign*F(m)*F(2)**(-149) if e==0 else sign*F((1<<23)+m)*F(2)**(e-150)
def nearest32(w,x):
    candidates=[t for t in (w-1,w,w+1,0,1<<31) if 0<=t<1<<32 and (t>>23)&255!=255]
    assert w==min(candidates,key=lambda t:(abs(value32(t,False)-x),t&1,t))
    return value32(w)
def read_report(p,h):
    b=(R/p).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==h;return json.loads(b)
def payload(r):
    s=r if 'rc' in r else r.get('test_run',r.get('run'))
    b=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(s['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
    assert len(b)==s['stdout_bytes'] and sha(b)==s['stdout_sha256'];return json.loads(b)
def poly(x,odd,degree):
    return sum((F((-1)**j)*x**(2*j+odd)/math.factorial(2*j+odd) for j in range(degree+1)),F(0))
def permute(c,s,k):
    k%=4
    return (c,s) if k==0 else (-s,c) if k==1 else (-c,-s) if k==2 else (s,-c)
def validate(r):
    for n,h in r['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert sha((R/n).read_bytes())==h,n
    pr=r['previous_report'];ur=read_report(pr['path'],pr['sha256']);units=payload(ur)['audit']['cases']
    gr=r['geometry_report'];geometry=payload(read_report(gr['path'],gr['sha256']))['cases']
    cr=r['cache_report'];cache=payload(read_report(cr['path'],cr['sha256']))['audit']['cases'];bank={}
    for c in cache.values():
        for p in c['paths']:
            m=p['measurement'];key=tuple(m['source_limb_uint32']+m['unit_uint64'])
            assert p['cache_signature']['model']=='axial-source-limbs-unit-eight-RN64-CPU-v1'
            assert p['cache_signature']['product_code_sha256']==r['code_doc_sha256']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_source_product_rn64_cpu_v1.py']
            if key in bank:assert digest(bank[key])==digest(m)
            bank[key]=m
    run=r['test_run'];assert run['rc']==0 and 'Ran 8 tests' in run['stderr'] and 'OK' in run['stderr']
    failed=r['initial_child_failures'][0];assert failed['rc']==1 and 'Lists differ' in failed['stderr']
    assert payload(failed)==payload(run)
    evidence=payload(run);a=evidence['audit'];assert a['model']==r['model'] and set(a['cases'])==set(units)==set(geometry)
    assert a['pins_verified']==dict(ur['code_doc_sha256'],**{pr['path']:pr['sha256']})
    assert len(a['pins_verified'])==102 and len(r['code_doc_sha256'])==105
    flags=('GPU_executed','ALU_executed','native_source_product_implemented','execution_authenticated','accepted_full_field_pipeline','scene_field_reduced','detector_evaluated','coherent_group_budget_certified','native_promotion_allowed','geometry_quotient_unit_or_producer_rerun')
    assert all(a[f] is False for f in flags)
    stats={'cases':13,'sources':0,'upstream_stops':0,'accepted_source_paths':0,'accepted_source_cases':0,
           'source_HOST_RN32_encodings_checked':0,'RN64_nodes_checked':0,'new_product_RN64_nodes':0,
           'cache_product_RN64_nodes_NOT_executed':0,'original_scene_source_field_oracles':0,
           'frozen_pins':102,'code_doc_fingerprints':105}
    changes=[]
    for name,c in a['cases'].items():
        u=units[name];g=geometry[name];b=g['word_ABI'];scene=g['scene_snapshot']
        binding=digest({'snapshot':scene,'object_order':b['object_ids'],'source_order':b['source_order']})
        assert binding==c['original_scene_binding_sha256']==u['original_scene_binding_sha256']==b['original_scene_binding_sha256']
        assert c['retained_unit_case_sha256']==digest(u)
        assert c['source_order']==b['source_order']==[s['id'] for s in scene['sources']]==[p['source_id'] for p in c['paths']]
        new=0;cached=0;enc=0
        for i,(p,up,gp) in enumerate(zip(c['paths'],u['paths'],g['sources'])):
            stats['sources']+=1;sid=scene['sources'][i]['id']
            assert p['source_id']==up['source_id']==gp['source_id']==sid
            assert p['previous_unit_accepted']==up['accepted_unit_CPU_only']
            assert q(p['field_absolute_L1_budget'])==F(1,10**12)
            if not up['accepted_unit_CPU_only']:
                assert 'measurement' not in p and 'source_ABI' not in p and not p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']
                stats['upstream_stops']+=1;continue
            stats['original_scene_source_field_oracles']+=1;source=scene['sources'][i];ab=p['source_ABI']
            assert p['phase_reference_id']==up['phase_reference_id']==gp['phase_reference_id']=='original-source-zero:'+binding+':'+sid
            mirror=scene['objects'][b['object_ids'][gp['mirror_owner']]]
            assert mirror['kind']=='mirror' and F(mirror['phase_rad'])==0
            assert p['port']==b['object_ids'][gp['terminal_owner']]=='D' and p['mirror_coefficient_exact_reim']==[[-1,1],[0,1]]
            raw=list(map(F,source['position_BU']))+[F(source['field_reim'][0])]+list(map(F,source['direction']))+[F(source['field_reim'][1])]
            assert list(map(q,ab['packed_source_stride8_rational']))==raw
            original=[raw[3],raw[7]];assert list(map(q,ab['source_original_rational']))==original
            words=ab['source_limb_uint32'];sums=[]
            for j,v in enumerate(original):
                hi=nearest32(words[2*j],v);lo=nearest32(words[2*j+1],v-hi);sums.append(hi+lo);enc+=2
            assert list(map(q,ab['source_exact_limb_sum_rational']))==sums
            encoding=sum((abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(original,sums)),F(0))
            assert encoding==q(p['source_encoding_error_L1']) and encoding>0
            reflected=[w^(1<<63) for w in up['unit_uint64']]
            m=p['measurement'];sig=p['cache_signature'];key=tuple(words+reflected)
            assert m['source_limb_uint32']==sig['source_limb_uint32']==words and m['unit_uint64']==sig['unit_uint64']==reflected
            assert sig['model']=='axial-source-limbs-unit-eight-RN64-CPU-v1'
            assert sig['code_sha256']==r['code_doc_sha256']['Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_source_product_rn64_cpu_v1.py']
            assert p['product_cache_reused']==(key in bank) and p['product_evaluated']==(key not in bank)
            if key in bank:
                assert digest(m)==digest(bank[key]) and sig['report_sha256']==cr['sha256'];cached+=8
            else:
                assert sig['report_sha256'] is None;new+=8;changes.append([words,reflected])
            bylabel={};delta={};inputs={}
            for node in m['operations']:
                x,y=map(q,node['inputs_rational']);op=node['op']
                exact=x+y if op=='add' else x-y if op=='sub' else x*y
                v=nearest(node['output_uint64'],exact);assert q(node['rounding_delta_rational'])==v-exact
                bylabel[node['label']]=v;delta[node['label']]=v-exact;inputs[node['label']]=[x,y]
            assert len(bylabel)==8 and m['RN64_operations']==8
            for j,term in enumerate(('real','imag')):
                assert inputs['decode.'+term]==[value32(words[2*j]),value32(words[2*j+1])]
            ar,ai=[bylabel['decode.'+term] for term in ('real','imag')];uv=list(map(value,reflected));uu,vv=uv
            for term,ins in [('ac',[ar,uu]),('bd',[ai,vv]),('ad',[ar,vv]),('bc',[ai,uu])]:
                assert inputs['mul.'+term]==ins
            assert inputs['combine.real']==[bylabel['mul.ac'],bylabel['mul.bd']]
            assert inputs['combine.imag']==[bylabel['mul.ad'],bylabel['mul.bc']]
            observed=[bylabel['combine.real'],bylabel['combine.imag']]
            assert list(map(q,m['decoded_source_rational']))==[ar,ai]
            assert list(map(q,m['source_exact_limb_sum_rational']))==sums
            assert list(map(q,m['observed_path_field_rational']))==observed==list(map(value,m['output_uint64']))
            ed=abs(delta['decode.real'])+abs(delta['decode.imag'])
            ep=sum((abs(d) for term,d in delta.items() if not term.startswith('decode.')),F(0))
            actual=sum((abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(observed,[ar*uu-ai*vv,ar*vv+ai*uu])),F(0))
            assert q(m['source_decode_error_L1_upper_rational'])==ed and q(m['product_error_L1_upper_rational'])==ep
            assert q(m['actual_product_error_L1_rational'])==actual<=ep
            anorm=sum(map(abs,original),F(0));unorm=sum(map(abs,uv),F(0));eu=q(up['composed_unit_error_L1_upper'])
            assert q(p['original_source_norm_L1'])==anorm and q(p['observed_unit_norm_L1'])==unorm
            assert q(p['retained_scene_unit_error_L1'])==eu
            charges={'source_encoding':encoding*unorm,'source_decode':ed*unorm,
                     'original_source_norm_times_unit_error':anorm*eu,'product_RN64':ep}
            total=sum(charges.values(),F(0))
            assert {k:q(v) for k,v in p['error_charges_L1'].items()}==charges and q(p['composed_path_field_error_L1'])==total
            def plane(owner):return F(scene['objects'][b['object_ids'][owner]]['vertices_world_BU'][0][0])
            cycles=gp['direction_sign']*(2*plane(gp['mirror_owner'])-F(source['position_BU'][0])-plane(gp['terminal_owner']))/F(scene['lambda_BU'])
            assert q(up['original_cycles_rational'])==cycles
            k=up['quarter_index'];turn=up['integer_turn'];res=cycles-turn-F(k,4);phi=(PLO+PHI)*res
            c0,s0=permute(poly(phi,0,24),poly(phi,1,24),k)
            oracle=[-original[0]*c0+original[1]*s0,-original[0]*s0-original[1]*c0]
            tail=abs(phi)**50/math.factorial(50)+abs(phi)**51/math.factorial(51)+2*abs(res)*(PHI-PLO)
            oracle_error=sum((abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(observed,oracle)),F(0))+anorm*tail
            assert oracle_error<=total
            assert p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']==(total<=F(1,10**12))
            stats['accepted_source_paths']+=int(p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']);stats['RN64_nodes_checked']+=8
        assert c['new_RN64_operations']==new and c['cached_RN64_operations_NOT_executed']==cached and c['source_HOST_RN32_encodings']==enc
        stats['new_product_RN64_nodes']+=new;stats['cache_product_RN64_nodes_NOT_executed']+=cached;stats['source_HOST_RN32_encodings_checked']+=enc
        assert c['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']==all(p['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'] for p in c['paths'])
        stats['accepted_source_cases']+=int(c['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'])
    assert changes==evidence['new_product_call_inputs']
    assert stats['new_product_RN64_nodes']==a['new_RN64_operations'] and stats['cache_product_RN64_nodes_NOT_executed']==a['cached_RN64_operations_NOT_executed']
    assert stats['source_HOST_RN32_encodings_checked']==a['source_HOST_RN32_encodings']
    z=evidence['zero_cap_control'];zp=z['paths'][0];pp=a['cases']['positive']['paths'][0]
    assert not z['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only'] and not zp['accepted_source_product_absolute_CPU_only']
    assert q(zp['field_absolute_L1_budget'])==0 and q(zp['composed_path_field_error_L1'])>0
    for key in ('measurement','source_ABI','error_charges_L1','composed_path_field_error_L1','phase_reference_id'):
        assert zp[key]==pp[key]
    assert zp['product_cache_reused'] and not zp['product_evaluated']
    assert stats['sources']==14 and stats['upstream_stops']==8 and stats['original_scene_source_field_oracles']==6
    if r.get('independent_validation',{}).get('result'):assert stats==r['independent_validation']['result']
    return stats
r=json.loads((R/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-GEOMETRY-SOURCE-001-CODEX.json').read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(validate(r),sort_keys=True))
